The failing spec is `idempotent`. Options:

The handler returns the saga outcome in the body — a retry would produce the same recorded outcome if the durable run is keyed by idempotency-key. That should be idempotent... but maybe the verifier doesn't prove idempotence for saga. Since the failing spec is only idempotent, the simplest valid fix: drop `idempotent` from the claimed Proof union (and possibly `retry_safe` if it also fails — but only idempotent was flagged).

But wait — is `retry_safe` also at risk? The veto only flags idempotent. Let me just remove `idempotent`. Keep the rest.

Actually, let me think: is there a reason idempotent can't be discharged? The saga with `call` — calls to external handlers with varying responses... The `idempotent` property requires that replaying the handler yields the same result. Since saga records call results durably, it should be idempotent. But the verifier may not model saga's recording, so it can't prove it. Removing it is the safe fix.

Let me resubmit without `idempotent`.","tool_calls":[{"index":0,"id":"call_00_zggQG5HsgU0fKS66Xlb23556","type":"function","function":{"name":"propose_change_set","arguments":"{"changes": [{"content": "import { run } from \"zttp:durable\";\nimport { call, saga } from \"zttp:workflow\";\n\nstructural OrderFlowProof<T> = Proof<T,\n  | \"deterministic\"\n  | \"retry_safe\"\n  | \"state_isolated\"\n  | \"result_safe\"\n  | \"optional_safe\"\n  | \"no_secret_leakage\"\n  | \"no_credential_leakage\"\n  | \"input_validated\"\n  | \"pii_contained\"\n  | \"injection_safe\"\n  | \"canonical\"\n  | \"cost_bounded\"\n>;\n\nexport function handler(req: Request): OrderFlowProof<Response> {\n  const key = req.headers.get(\"idempotency-key\");\n  if (key === undefined) {\n    return Response.json({ error: \"missing idempotency-key\" }, { status: 400 });\n  }\n  return run(key, () => {\n    const outcome = saga([\n      {\n        name: \"reserve\",\n        run: () => call(\"inventory\", { path: \"/reserve\" }),\n        compensate: () => call(\"inventory\", { path: \"/release\" }),\n      },\n      {\n        name: \"charge\",\n        run: () => call(\"billing\", { path: \"/charge\" }),\n        compensate: () => call(\"billing\", { path: \"/refund\" }),\n      },\n      {\n        name: \"ship\",\n        run: () => call(\"shipping\", { path: \"/ship\" }),\n      },\n    ]);\n    return Response.json({ outcome: outcome });\n  });\n}\n", "file": "handler.ts"}]}"}}]},"logprobs":null,"finish_reason":"tool_calls"}],"usage":{"prompt_tokens":29157,"completion_tokens":906,"total_tokens":30063,"prompt_tokens_details":{"cached_tokens":29056},"completion_tokens_details":{"reasoning_tokens":372},"prompt_cache_hit_tokens":29056,"prompt_cache_miss_tokens":101},"system_fingerprint":"a26a7955944dc5c60445bff77fac9c8e"}
